description: Defines the User class for session management and user attributes within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Manages user session attributes, authentication status, roles, and flash messages within the OrangeHRM authentication system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Implements singleton pattern to get the single instance of User.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with a given name and value.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by name, with optional default.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a session attribute exists.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute by name.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Returns all session attributes as an array.

methods.name: addFlash
methods.description: Adds a flash message of a specific type.

methods.name: getFlash
methods.description: Retrieves flash messages of a specific type.

methods.name: hasFlash
methods.description: Checks if flash messages of a specific type exist.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: setIsAuthenticated
methods.description: Sets the user's authentication status.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Gets the user ID.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID.

methods.name: getUserRoleId
methods.description: Gets the user role ID.

methods.name: setUserRoleId
methods.description: Sets the user role ID.

methods.name: getUserRoleName
methods.description: Gets the user role name.

methods.name: setUserRoleName
methods.description: Sets the user role name.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Gets the employee number.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number.

methods.name: getUserLastModified
methods.description: Gets the last modified timestamp of the user.

methods.name: setUserLastModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp of the user.

methods.name: getHasAdminAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has admin access.

methods.name: setHasAdminAccess
methods.description: Sets the admin access status for the user.
